{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in body_mass_g
missing_body_mass = df['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()
print(f'Missing values in body_mass_g: {missing_body_mass}')

# Drop rows with missing body_mass_g and compute the mean
mean_body_mass = df['body_mass_g'].dropna().mean()
print(f'Mean body mass (grams): {mean_body_mass}')"}
